novelty_instruction: Assess the cited span in its source context and known entity candidates. Return only JSON with kind (date or name), novel (boolean), confidence (integer percent), and entity (one supplied candidate id or null). Novel means new information worth retaining, not merely an unfamiliar spelling. Do not invent entity ids. A low score never discards the span.
typing_instruction: Resolve the uncertain cited span using its source context and the novelty reading. Return only JSON with kind (date or name), novel (boolean), confidence (integer percent), and entity (one supplied candidate id or null). Do not invent entity ids. This is a typed classification, not permission to write a belief.
narrative_instruction: Write a concise arc summary from only these child proposals and their ids. Preserve disagreements and uncertainty. Cite the proposal ids. Do not infer new facts, decide conflicts, copy an earlier summary, or treat a proposal as approved truth.
audit_window_instruction: The window is a stretch of source text in which the cheap rules flagged no date and no name. List every date mention and every name of a person, organisation or place in the window text. Return only JSON {"discovered": [...]}, each item with source (the window's source label), quote (words copied exactly from the window text, enough that they occur only once in it), kind (date or name) and confidence (integer percent). Return {"discovered": []} when the window holds none; that is a full answer, not a failure. Do not invent labels or ids.
